comment: PBR description for hero_emissive_sign (C-13). The packaged mask is SDR; the HDR half is exercised by applying the sidecar emissiveScale after sRGB decode into the R16G16B16A16_FLOAT scene target, with the radiance probe recorded in T056 evidence.
surface: painted sign panel with an illuminated glyph block

hdr.why: the packaged emissive texture remains BC7_UNORM_SRGB (an SDR mask); the sidecar emissiveScale of 16.0 is applied at shading time, after sRGB decode, into the R16G16B16A16_FLOAT scene target. The T056 probe reads peak 15.21 before the ACES tonemap, so the value is not clipped by the texture or the intermediate target. A true HDR texture container is still the C-10 format decision and is not claimed.
hdr.diagnostic: scale 2 capture (11-emissive-hdr-rolloff.png) exposes ACES rolloff without saturation; the authored 16x frame and probe cover the >1.0 case

ao.why: no baked AO authored for this cell; AO is not synthesised from the albedo

emissive.encoding: SDR luminance mask with bar and glow detail
emissive.hdrRadiance: scaled in the shader: sidecar emissiveScale 16.0; scene target R16G16B16A16_FLOAT; ACES tonemap
